archetypes.name: White-Blue Detain
archetypes.plan: Use detain to remove blockers for a turn while an efficient creature curve keeps attacking.

archetypes.name: Blue-Red Overload
archetypes.plan: Trade tempo early, then turn flexible overload spells into late-game card advantage.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Unleash
archetypes.plan: Deploy unleashed creatures on curve and use removal to keep the opponent from stabilizing.

archetypes.name: Black-Green Scavenge
archetypes.plan: Trade creatures early and reuse them through scavenge to make every later threat larger.

archetypes.name: Green-White Populate
archetypes.plan: Create a large creature token, copy it with populate, and win through a widening board.
